name: Not Returned
description: A 1/1 still. The apparatus from yesterday is dark. The wet stroke remains. The fainter stroke beside it matches too closely, as if written by the same hand, not returned by the wall or by a keeper. The floor where someone would have stood is empty. People grant awareness for what an agent does, and withhold consciousness as what an agent is. A look that stops may be only a record. This piece can show the doing. It cannot show the being. It does not know if the empty place means no one looked, or that looking happened and was not kept.
